case.message: Is the illustrated 4% interest rate guaranteed? How does it differ from the 2.5% guarantee?

claims.text: No. The illustrated 4% p.a. is identified as the “Current assumed rate,” and the brochure states that the current assumed base crediting rate is not guaranteed and may change; it was quoted as of the brochure’s January 2022 print date.

The 2.5% guarantee is different: once the policy has been in force for 15 years or more, the Account Value is guaranteed to accumulate to at least the amount that would result if interest had been credited at 2.5% p.a., regardless of economic conditions.

The guarantee concerns the Account Value, including credited interest and Extra Bonus, and premiums are credited after deduction of applicable charges; it is therefore not a guarantee that every premium will be returned or that the account will earn 4%.

The brochure also lists a 0.25% retrospective additional-interest rate as a current assumption, not a guarantee; crediting rates and non-guaranteed bonuses are reviewed and determined from time to time.
